description: Rules that say when a save, or the running game, holds a state our mods should never be in (docs/development/test-automation.md). Save checks: python scripts/query-save.py checks. Live checks, which take a snapshot of the running game (ask the owner first): python scripts/perf.py look-check. How a check is written: external/phobos-modkit/docs/checks.md. A rule's note (kit 1.129.0) gives figures for the test list, read by test-pass from the newest saves and judged by config/test-evidence.json. A finding is not an in-game test, and a rule can be wrong.

checks.title: Vehicles saved no NaN or infinity in our values
checks.why: A NaN or infinity is the mark of a division by nothing; once saved it spreads through every figure worked out from it.

checks.title: Vehicles refer only to things the save holds
checks.why: The game drops a reference to a thing it cannot find when it loads, with an error: a hitch, a winch or a crew job left pointing at nothing.

checks.title: A vehicle's battery charge, coolant and oil stay between empty and full
checks.fault: min([charge, coolant, oil]) < 0 or max([charge, coolant, oil]) > 1.0001
checks.why: Each is a share of full (Framework's vehicle systems); outside 0 to 1 a rule has added or taken past its end. The 0.0001 allows for rounding.

checks.title: No vehicle part's health is below nothing
A vehicle's event log keeps no more than its 64 events
checks.why: VehicleEventLog.MaxCount is 64; more means its trimming stopped working and the save will keep growing.

checks.title: A vehicle's logbook keeps no more than its 200 entries
checks.why: LogbookRule.DefaultCap is 200; more means its trimming stopped working.

checks.title: A work store holds far more than any order of fittings takes
checks.says: {sum(stacks)} things laid out ({unique(kinds)}) for {count(orders)} fit orders
checks.why: Since Framework 0.286.2 the store keeps only what the waiting work needs. 300 is an authored line: about the most steel a heavy truck's dearest fittings take together.

checks.title: A work store holds no more than its waiting work could use
checks.says: {vehicle}{number}: {sum(held)} laid out, its waiting repairs and fittings could use {sum(needs)}
checks.why: Reads every option of every waiting repair, so it allows more than the store keeps. Due services' supplies are not read: 100 is an authored allowance for them.

checks.title: No destroyed vehicle's systems are still held in memory
checks.why: A snapshot includes garbage the collector has not reclaimed yet: a finding here is a leak only if python scripts/perf.py look-why Phobos.VehicleSystems.CompPhobosVehicleSystems finds something still holding it.

checks.title: Each jet's guns are its own mod's copy of the fixed-wing code
checks.fault: (jet == "Harrier_Jet" and (contains(guns, "CloseAirSupport.Flight.VtolVehicleTurret") or contains(guns, "EA6BProwler.Flight.VtolVehicleTurret"))) or ((jet == "Warthog_Jet" or jet == "Frogfoot_Jet") and (contains(guns, "AV8BHarrier.Flight.VtolVehicleTurret") or contains(guns, "EA6BProwler.Flight.VtolVehicleTurret"))) or (jet == "Prowler_Jet" and (contains(guns, "AV8BHarrier.Flight.VtolVehicleTurret") or contains(guns, "CloseAirSupport.Flight.VtolVehicleTurret")))
checks.says: a {jet} saved with another jet mod's guns: {unique(guns)}
checks.why: Since 26 Nov 2026 the Harrier, Close Air Support and the Prowler each carry their own copy of the flight code. A jet saved under another mod's copy runs that code without its own fixed-wing data: no Sortie, a hover for a take-off (Patches 0.45.2 puts it right on load). A check cannot read a thing's own class, so this reads its guns, saved with it.

checks.title: A graded Cherokee chemtank's health follows its grade, through a save
checks.why: Figures for row 9 (test automation round two, 26 Nov 2026). A grade's healthFactor (PartGrades.xml: heavy-duty 1.3, salvaged 0.7) raises or lowers a part's maximum, and a load puts it back before health is restored, so a saved health above 120 can only be the raised maximum kept through a save; nothing can go above 156. 120 is the Chemtank's health in Vanilla Vehicles Expanded's Cherokee, and li[19] its place among the Cherokee's parts, both as of 26 Nov 2026: Vehicle Framework saves its own parts by place, not name, so a VVE update that reorders them makes this read another part. Only a Cherokee with one graded part is read, so the grade read is the chemtank's.

checks.title: A Cherokee's ferry tank holds three quarters again, and no more
checks.says: fuel {fuel}, above the 735 a stock tank and a ferry tank hold
checks.why: Figures for row 67 (test automation round two). The ferry tank's fuelCapacityFactor is 1.75 (Fittings.xml), so fuel above the stock tank's 420 (Vanilla Vehicles Expanded's Cherokee) shows the larger capacity in force, and above 735 is the capacity that keeps growing after a save and load, which the row watches for.

checks.title: A Harrier's ferry tank holds three quarters again, and no more
checks.says: fuel {fuel}, above the 437.5 a stock tank and a ferry tank hold
checks.why: As for the Cherokee: the Harrier's stock tank is 250. The Harrier saves its own vehicle class, so it is chosen by its def: a class select of Vehicles.VehiclePawn never reaches it.
